notes: The portfolio site's own look, as a Pancake topping: monochrome Core light/dark from test-wisp globals.css.
The site's Fun themes (Electric, Neon, Signal, Albers) become their own toppings later.
Neutral anchors are the site's real values (the 4% / 15% overlays flattened on white and black); only 300, 600 and 700 are generated.
